round_note: Fall cleaning and cozy-season staples, plus small beauty and tech gifts that are easy to grab before the holiday rush.

picks.name: Fire TV Stick HD
picks.why: The cheapest way to make an older TV smart, and still one of Amazon's best-selling devices this month.

picks.name: Anker Nano Power Bank
picks.why: Pocket-size charger with a built-in connector, so there's no cable to forget. A favorite stocking stuffer.
picks.query: Anker Nano Power Bank built-in connector

picks.name: Amazon Smart Plug (2-Pack)
picks.why: Put lamps and holiday lights on a schedule or Alexa voice control. One of the most-reviewed smart home items on Amazon.

picks.name: Swiffer WetJet Hardwood Starter Kit
picks.why: Lightweight spray mop with a built-in cleaning solution. A go-to for quick floor cleanups before guests arrive.
picks.query: Swiffer WetJet Hardwood Floor Mop Starter Kit

picks.name: Lysol Disinfecting Wipes (4-Pack)
picks.why: Multi-surface wipes for kitchens and bathrooms. Families stock up on them heading into cold and flu season.

picks.name: Tide Pods Free & Gentle
picks.why: Unscented, hypoallergenic laundry pods with a huge fan base among people with sensitive skin.
picks.query: Tide Pods Free and Gentle laundry detergent pacs

picks.name: Hoto 25-Piece Electric Screwdriver Kit
picks.why: Rechargeable screwdriver with 25 bits in a tidy case. A practical gift that keeps selling after the October sale.

picks.name: KitchenAid Silicone Oven Mitts (2-Pack)
picks.why: Ribbed silicone mitts with a soft lining, ready for holiday baking. A top kitchen seller this month.
picks.query: KitchenAid Ribbed Soft Silicone Oven Mitt 2 pack

picks.name: Medicube Toner Pads
picks.why: K-beauty toner pads that were among the best-selling skincare of October. A quick, no-mess way to prep skin.

picks.name: LANEIGE Lip Glowy Balm
picks.why: Tinted, glossy lip balm that moisturizes without feeling sticky. A beauty best seller and an easy small gift.

picks.name: Pantene Miracle Rescue 10-in-1 Spray
picks.why: One spray that works as a heat protectant, detangler and shine treatment. Budget-friendly hair care with a following.

picks.name: Grace & Stella Under Eye Patches Variety Set
picks.why: Three kinds of cooling under-eye patches in one box, from a brand that's long been an Amazon beauty favorite.
picks.query: Grace and Stella under eye patches variety set

picks.name: EverFoams Fuzzy Slippers
picks.why: Faux-fur slippers with memory foam and a non-slip sole. Cold-weather favorites that sell out by December.
picks.query: EverFoams women's fuzzy memory foam slippers

picks.name: Owala FreeSip 40 oz Water Bottle
picks.why: Insulated bottle you can sip through the straw or swig from the spout. One of the most-bought water bottles on Amazon.
picks.query: Owala FreeSip 40 oz stainless steel water bottle

picks.name: FYY Travel Cable Organizer Pouch
picks.why: Waterproof pouch with sections for chargers and earbuds. Handy before holiday trips.
